text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen, huh? Feels like a 
dream, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd get to clash with her again 
after parting ways. And on this grand 
stage, no less."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm really happy too, so much!

text_block_list.text:
Looking back, Jungle Pocket's life had 
been nothing but goodbyes until now. 
However—

As long as you keep running in high 
spirits, there's always a chance you'll 
cross paths again.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shut up, Dantsu. Who're you callin' 
Pokkekke-chan? But still—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're workin' hard in your 
races. I've been keepin' an eye on your 
success, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like the mile is a better fit 
for me after all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame! After last year's Kikuka 
Sho, she switched to the mile division and 
has produced great results.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Will that sharp turn of foot hold up 
against Jungle Pocket at medium distance?! 
Today is a must-see!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You know, Pokke-chan... Even while running 
the Mile route, I never once forgot the 
way you run.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Someday... I'll run once again. Because 
Pokke-chan told me we'd meet at medium 
distance."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Compared to usual, 2,200 meters 
might be a bit long for you. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I already know. You're an Umamusume who 
can overcome a handicap like that."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Dants. Heh, my blood is boiling. 
Let's settle last year's unfinished 
business.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even if everyone else is gone, this isn't 
over. Not the battle between you and me!
